program.name: Bodyweight Circuits Plus
program.subject: Bodyweight
program.blurb: Three bodyweight circuits: upper, lower and full body, round after round.
program.about: Three circuits in rotation, all on the floor. The upper circuit is push-ups, floor pulls and pike work; the lower is squats, lunges, bridges and calf raises; the full-body one mixes both with core. Short rests, steady rounds. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Upper circuit / lower circuit / full circuit
